caseName: Westvaco Corp. v. Adams Extract Co.
caseNameFull: Westvaco Corp. v. Adams Extract Co.

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 447 U. S. 919.] Motion of respondents Owens-Illinois, Inc., et al. to dismiss the writ of certiorari granted. Motion of Westvaco Corp. to dismiss the writ of certiorari pursuant to Rule 53 granted. Motion of Mead Corp. for leave to intervene as a party petitioner denied. Certiorari dismissed.

Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
